title: Reorder
description: A ranked list that re-sorts itself — rows glide to their new positions instead of jumping.
a11y: Rows keep their text and rank numbers after every move, so screen readers follow the final order. Autoplay re-ranks every 3 seconds; it pauses while a pointer or keyboard focus is inside the panel, a Pause toggle (aria-pressed) stops it, and it never starts under prefers-reduced-motion. A status region announces manual re-ranks only. Motion scales with --k-mscale and is skipped at zero. Screen-reader output is not yet verified by hand.
